mainline: dense Qwen3.5-9B student; SFT cold-start -> agentic RL (GRPO, DSH multi-turn, SWE-Gym/SWE-smith) -> OPD (Qwen3.5-27B teacher, slime native --use-opd sglang mode, additive reverse-KL over GRPO); no loop surgery on the mainline

framework.name: slime
framework.working_tree: must stay unmodified; all entry scripts live project-local
framework.trainer: slime native Megatron pipeline; no custom trainer

models.student_mcore_status: pending: convert_hf_to_torch_dist.py run requires the megatron-prep environment (E1.b remaining item)
models.teacher_serving: external SGLang server on a dedicated H100, tp=1, ~54GB BF16 weights; sglang OPD mode fetches per-token logprobs via --rm-url <server>/generate
models.teacher_rule: sole teacher for both any recovery-style use and the agent stage; same tokenizer family as student (vocab 248320)

sft_pool.schema: messages (multi-turn) + metadata(source, instance_id, task_sha256, n_turns, n_tokens)
sft_pool.length_profile: chat-templated full-trajectory tokens p50~19k p90~30k p99~42k max~54k; 40% <=16k, 93.5% <=32k

opd_pool.content: single-user-message task descriptions extracted from the same trajectories (deduped by task hash)
opd_pool.role: prompt-only OPD smoke (no environments) and reference pool; the real agent-OPD stage runs on SWE-Gym/SWE-smith task environments

data.agent_task_pools: SWE-Gym + SWE-smith under the existing buggy/gold validation and exclusion audit (configs/gym-training-exclusion.json, data/agent-rl/exclusion-audit.json, configs/swe-three-tasks.json)

1_sft_coldstart.required_flag: --loss-mask-type qwen3_5 (default 'qwen' per-message rendering raises TemplateError 'No user query found' on this data; verified CPU-side)
1_sft_coldstart.cpu_acceptance: runtime/prompt-pool/cpu-acceptance.json (Dataset load + loss-mask assistant-span correctness + token annotation cross-check)
1_sft_coldstart.defaults_from: official retool SFT example (lr 1e-5 cosine, wd 0.1, dynamic batch); hyperparameter changes need user consent

2_agent_rl.status: pending environment wiring: DSH registered to upstream BaseHarness lifecycle (slime_dsh/ exists, CPU-verified) + SWE-Gym/SWE-smith task envs + test-pass rewards
2_agent_rl.gpus: 3 H100 student train+rollout (colocate) after stage 3 mechanics land

3_opd.mode_prompt_smoke: pure OPD on opd-prompts.parquet (teacher KL only, scalar reward 0, GRPO estimator on zero rewards) - validates teacher server + rm plumbing without task envs
3_opd.mode_agent: DSH multi-turn + test-pass rewards + --use-opd additive KL (target state per frozen design)

4_eval.protocol: HumanEvalPlus base-check (dense 9B zero-shot reference 96.9% recorded) + SWE-bench Verified frozen subset official harness; baseline rows: Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.8-27B (generation-only), Ouro-2.6B-Thinking
4_eval.rule: official benchmarks keep official protocols; self-run results never labeled official without the official harness

gpu_discipline.record: configs/gpu-allocation.json (UUID, purpose, time) before use; stop and verify release after
prerequisites_before_first_gpu_run: megatron-prep environment (pinned Megatron-LM 1dcf0da + slime megatron.patch) built and verified CPU-side
convert_hf_to_torch_dist.py run on the 9B student with MODEL_ARGS from scripts/models/qwen3.5-9B.sh
training entry scripts reviewed by user (hyperparameters are official-example defaults, not user-approved yet)

wandb: online mode is the default and must not be changed without explicit user approval
